main_topics: Building personal connections through social media

episode_summary: Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of using video content and personal stories to enhance social media engagement for real estate agents. She emphasizes building connections and credibility by sharing personal experiences and client success stories. The episode provides actionable strategies for leveraging social media to build a trusted personal brand.
